summary: Iteration 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass covering Excel template download, Excel import (auto-creates categories, returns {imported,errors}), full shift open/close flow with correct variance math (opening 100 + cash_sales 80 - returns 40 -> expected 140; closing 175 -> variance +35), GET /api/shifts listing with summary, /api/payments/checkout returns checkout_url+session_id+amount+months, /api/payments/status returns payment_status=pending, super_admin blocked from checkout. Frontend: shift badge shows 'فتح وردية' initially, paying without shift triggers 'يرجى فتح وردية أولاً' toast, opening shift changes badge to 'وردية مفتوحة • 100.00', successful sale opens receipt modal showing shop name + invoice #1 + item + total, Products page has 'استيراد Excel' and 'قالب' buttons, RenewBanner appears on dashboard when subscription <30 days ('اشتراكك ينتهي خلال 10 يوم' + 'جدّد سنة كاملة' button).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~940 lines and growing — consider splitting into modules (auth, shops, products, sales, shifts, payments, reports) for maintainability.
In /shifts/close, `closing_cash = data.closing_cash or 0` treats a legitimate 0.0 the same as None — acceptable but explicit `None`-check would be cleaner.
In /payments/checkout: yearly price hard-defaults to $99 via env; amount is not validated against a min value.
STRIPE_API_KEY default 'sk_test_emergent' is embedded via os.environ.get default — fine for dev, ensure production env sets it explicitly.

Iteration 1 open finding still stands (LOW): require_shop_user calls datetime.fromisoformat on subscription_expires_at without isinstance guard — 500s if any code path stores it as native BSON date (not reachable via app APIs).
test_credentials: Super admin admin@pos.com / Admin@1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test shops created dynamically with prefix TEST_it2_shop_* and TEST_ui2_shop_*.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral shops/products with TEST_ prefix; no cleanup performed (safe due to prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 features (Excel import/template, Shifts+variance, Stripe checkout, Receipt modal, RenewBanner) fully validated. pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py can be re-run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration2.py -v -o addopts=''`. Note pytest.ini uses xdist by default; the -o override disables it. Iteration 1 file at /app/test_reports/iteration_1.json.
